title: Agent Pay token inside a Stripe Shared Payment Token
summary: Stripe provisions a Mastercard agentic network token scoped to the customer's intent and, in Stripe's wording, shares it with the agent; the seller receives only a Shared Payment Token, which the agent issues. This is how an ACP checkout processed by Stripe can carry an Agent Pay token.

steps.label: Authorize agent purchase
steps.detail: The customer authorizes the agent to pay.

steps.label: Provision agentic network token
steps.detail: Stripe requests a Mastercard agentic network token scoped to the customer's intent.

steps.label: Share with the agent
steps.detail: Stripe shares the agentic network token with the agent (Stripe's wording); the seller receives only a Shared Payment Token, which the agent issues.

steps.label: Pay with SPT
steps.detail: The agent passes the SPT to a seller on Stripe, for example inside an ACP checkout. Sellers on Stripe support agentic network tokens automatically.

steps.label: Authorize
steps.detail: At authorization the network maps the token to the latest funding PAN and includes additional information in the authorization message for the issuer.
